idea-plugin.name: Blockbench
idea-plugin.description:
Edit Blockbench models without leaving your JetBrains IDE.

Open a .bbmodel file to use the embedded Blockbench editor. Models are loaded directly from disk, and Ctrl/Cmd+S saves them using Blockbench's own codecs. The standard Text editor remains available for raw JSON.

Use an installed Blockbench runtime, a local web build, or a self-hosted URL. Configure BLOCKBENCH_URL or BLOCKBENCH_WEB_ROOT, or install a managed runtime from Settings/Preferences | Tools | Blockbench.

Blockbench settings and compatible plugins can be synchronized between the embedded runtime and the standalone Blockbench profile.
